title: Completed PROJECT SCHEDULE Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed PROJECT SCHEDULE artifact data payloads (PMO-04.03.08).

project_start_and_target_finish_dates.description: The authorized baseline start date and targeted project completion date.

schedule_data_version_and_baseline_statu.description: The formal schedule model version number and baseline authorization state.

total_critical_path_length_and_major_pha.description: Total working days on the critical path and scheduled durations for each major project phase.

wbs_code_and_activity_schedule_mapping.description: Consolidated schedule line items linking WBS code, activity title, and work package.

planned_start_and_finish_dates.description: Approved baseline start date and baseline completion date for each scheduled activity.

assigned_resources_and_effort_allocation.description: Designated resource leads, team members, and allocated effort hours per activity.

critical_path_flag_and_dependencies.description: Clear indicator (Yes/No) identifying critical path activities and predecessor linkages.

total_float_and_free_float_values.description: Calculated total float and free float values in working days for each schedule activity.

schedule_risk_and_recovery_consideration.description: Identification of high-risk scheduling bottlenecks and contingency deployment rules.
